text: The Everqueen's chosen archers rise beside Caledor's ancient dragonkind, defending Avelorn with blessed arrows and star-bright flame.

The Avelorn Dragon Knights are an oathbound order seldom seen beyond the Everqueen's court. Only the calmest and most flawless warriors among the Sisters of Avelorn are called to their ranks, for only they can endure the gaze of an ancient dragon soul without faltering. Beneath the sacred boughs they hone their discipline, and in the old songs of Caledor they learn to breathe with the dragons that bear them skyward. Their Star Dragons are no common mounts, but living echoes of the oldest pacts of Ulthuan. When such creatures consent to carry the Everqueen's archers between their wings, the purity of Avelorn and the majesty of Caledor are joined for one terrible purpose. In battle, the Dragon Knights loose blessed volleys from the cloud-shadow; when fear and fire have broken the foe's order, dragon wings descend, and talon, bow and unyielding oath sweep the defilers from the Queen's lands.
The eldest and mightiest dragons can slay entire regiments with a blast of white-hot flame.
Blades of the Gaen Vale (Avelorn Dragon Knights)
Chosen beneath the temples and palace walls of the Gaen Vale, these dragon-borne guardians watch the skies in the Everqueen's name.

The Gaen Vale is the heart of Avelorn, where the Everqueen's court and the oaths of the sacred forest meet. The Blades of the Gaen Vale are no ordinary dragon knights, but a household guard chosen once more from among the Avelorn Dragon Knights themselves. They have kept courtly discipline as guardians of the Queen, cleansed defilers with the archery of the Sisters of Avelorn, and learned to read the field from between the scales and furnace-heart of a Star Dragon. When enemies draw near to the groves and high walls of the Everqueen's realm, these wardens rise above the canopy, tearing open ranks with blessed moonbow volleys before the white-hot breath of their dragons consumes the most stubborn assault. Their presence is a promise made visible: the Queen's city shall not yield, and the light of the sacred forest shall not fail.
The eldest and mightiest dragons can exhale white-hot flame; the Star Dragons of the Blades of the Gaen Vale may use this breath twice per battle.
Upkeep: %+n% for Avelorn Dragon Knights and Blades of the Gaen Vale

At the opening of the campaign, Avelorn's dragon riders gather beneath the boughs of the Gaen Vale. The Everqueen may claim the funds reserved for their mustering, or call the warriors directly to her banner.
Gain 3000 gold to arrange the recruitment of the Avelorn Dragon Knights yourself.
Add one unit of Avelorn Dragon Knights to Alarielle's army.
Alarielle's army gains one unit of Avelorn Dragon Knights
